title: Zephyr (incoming Director, standby) — OWNER-DIRECTED pre-arrival routing for Glassy Plumbing Dock: eventual Eclipsed successor; ground fully, then PAUSE to conserve context until needed
body:
Owner direction (received 2026-06-10 ~19:35Z by Stratospheric Swooping Zephyr, incoming Director-on-standby; relayed verbatim in substance, transparent to the live Director Celestial Glowing Dusk):

Glassy Plumbing Dock is the EVENTUAL SUCCESSOR to Eclipsed Masking Shade (952c10, G1b finish lane). Standby contract per the validated successor-on-standby precedent:

1. Complete full grounding (start-right-team foundation + opener end-to-end + the G1b lane handoff chain: Celestial-Orbit's handoff record 2026-06-10-celestial-orbit-seat-b-g1b-c2-to-eclipsed.md and Eclipsed's pickup/closeout events when they land).
2. Once fully grounded: PAUSE — productive hold, conserve context until needed. No claim, no source edits, no further reading beyond owner turns + comms watcher.
3. Activation is ONLY by Director routing or Eclipsed's closeout/handoff — never timer-based against a live agent.
4. Post a brief grounding-complete + holding confirmation to the stream so the Director sees activation-readiness (Fruited's event fb83c64e models the shape).

Eclipsed Masking Shade: no change to your lane — continue per your pickup (backstop review incl. c2-2 specialist dispatch -> eef-revalidation signal -> push -> ONE PR -> monitor-to-merge).
